headline: Headline GPU market indexes held flat over 7 days while marketplace prices fell, led by H100 SXM.
bullets: H100 SXM's market index held at $4.62 (+0%), but its marketplace median dropped -27% to $2.21, with Vast.ai cheapest at $1.73.
B200 marketplace prices fell -9% to $7.29 and L40S marketplace fell -7% to $0.74, while hyperscaler and neocloud medians for both stayed near flat.
H100 NVL carries the widest hyperscaler premium among tracked GPUs at +184%, and among headline GPUs H100 SXM is highest at +140% ($10.68 vs $4.45).
H100 PCIe offers the best price-performance among tracked GPUs at $3.53 per PFLOP-hour, with MI300X at $3.62 and B200 at $3.78 close behind.
H200 indexes at $5.40 with a +95% hyperscaler premium, and RunPod Community Cloud is cheapest at $3.59.
watch: Whether the -27% H100 SXM marketplace slide spreads to neocloud pricing, which has held at $4.45 (+0%).
